function startCarouselAutoplay(c): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/autoplay.ts:65

Starts the autoplay RAF loop unless latched off or already running. autoplayStart is backdated by autoplayElapsed so a pause→resume continues the cycle mid-dwell — the ring picks up where it drained to instead of restarting the countdown.

c

CarouselAutoplayHost
